# Elasticity
$$\epsilon = \frac{\partial y}{\partial x} \cdot \frac{x}{y} = \frac{\partial \log(y)}{\partial \log(x)}$$

# ERA5
```{r parameters}
years <- 1970:2021
lonLim = c(-4.4, -4.41)
latLim = c(38.6, 38.61)
folder <- "~/plot/"
dataset <- "ERA5"
```

## load data
```{r load_data, message=FALSE}
source("load_data.R")
dat_fwi <- load_data(year = years, lonLim = lonLim, latLim = latLim, what = "FWI", dataset = dataset)
dat_isi <- load_data(year = years, lonLim = lonLim, latLim = latLim, what = "ISI", dataset = dataset)
dat_bui <- load_data(year = years, lonLim = lonLim, latLim = latLim, what = "BUI", dataset = dataset)
dat_ffmc <- load_data(year = years, lonLim = lonLim, latLim = latLim, what = "FFMC", dataset = dataset)
dat_wind <- load_data(year = years, lonLim = lonLim, latLim = latLim, what = "Wind", dataset = dataset)
# to km/h
dat_wind$Data <- dat_wind$Data * 3.6
```


## Wind vs FWI
```{r}
keep <- dat_fwi$Data > 1

ffmc_q <- as.numeric(cut(dat_ffmc$Data[keep],
                         breaks = quantile(dat_ffmc$Data[keep], probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE))
bui_q  <- as.numeric(cut(dat_bui$Data[keep],
                         breaks = quantile(dat_bui$Data[keep],  probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE))


data <- data.frame(
  x = dat_wind$Data[keep],
  y = dat_fwi$Data[keep],
  group = interaction(ffmc_q, bui_q)
)

n_groups <- nlevels(data$group)
pal      <- hcl.colors(n_groups, palette = "Zissou 1")
r_ffmc <- seq(0.2, 1, length.out = 5)  # FFMC drives red channel
b_bui  <- seq(0.2, 1, length.out = 5)  # BUI drives blue channel
col_mat <- outer(r_ffmc, b_bui, Vectorize(function(r, b) rgb(r, 0.2, b)))
pal <- col_mat
data$col <- pal[as.integer(data$group)]

plot(data$x, data$y, col  = data$col, pch = 16,
     xlab = "Wind (km/h)", ylab = "FWI",
     main = paste(dataset, "— FWI vs Wind"),
     sub  = "Colour = FFMC quintile × BUI quintile group")

groups     <- levels(data$group)
elasticity <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(groups)), groups)

for (g in groups) {
  subset_data <- data[data$group == g, ]
  if (nrow(subset_data) > 20) {
    model <- lm(log(y) ~ log(x), data = subset_data)
    elasticity[g] <- coef(model)[["log(x)"]]
    curve(exp(predict(model, newdata = data.frame(x = x))), add = TRUE, col = data$col[data$group == g][1], lwd = 2)
  }
}

elasticity_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = 5, ncol = 5)
for (fq in 1:5) {
  for (bq in 1:5) {
    g <- paste0(fq, ".", bq)
    elasticity_matrix[fq, bq] <- elasticity[g]
  }
}

plot(0, type = "n", xlim = c(0.5, 5.5), ylim = c(0.5, 5.5), xlab = "FFMC Quintile", ylab = "BUI Quintile", main = "Elasticity of FWI to Wind")
for (fq in 1:5) {
  for (bq in 1:5) {
    rect(bq - 0.5, fq - 0.5, bq + 0.5, fq + 0.5,
         col = col_mat[fq + (bq-1)*5], border = "white")
    text(bq, fq, labels = paste0(round(elasticity_matrix[fq, bq], 3)), cex = 2)
  }
}

library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

df <- melt(elasticity_matrix)

ggplot(df, aes(x = Var2, y = Var1, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 2))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "BUI Quintile",
    y = "FFMC Quintile",
    title = "Elasticity of FWI to Wind"
  )
```
